name: Progress M1-7
about: Progress M1-7 (2001-051A), a crewed vehicle (Progress M1), launched 2001 Nov 26. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2001 Nov 28), held fixed
docked to S26400; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
